whenToUse: A shopping cart page or mini-cart drawer with quantity steppers, discount codes and an order summary.
Stores that need free-delivery progress, delivery dates and an empty state with recommendations.
avoidWhen: Collecting address and payment — use checkout-01.
Editing invoice or quote lines in an admin — use line-items.
a11y: Sections are labelled with aria-labelledby; announce quantity changes and inline undo to screen readers.
Give each remove and stepper button an accessible name that includes the product.
